title: A Phase 2 Clinical Study of MIL62 in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: A Phase 2 Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Recombinant Humanized Monoclonal Antibody MIL62 Injection in the Treatment of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy, safety, pharmacokinetics(PK), pharmacodynamics(PD) and ADA of MIL62 compared with placebo in participants with systemic lupus erythematosus.

primary.m: Part A and Part B:Percentage of participants achieving SRI-4 at Week 12
